the benzimidazoles are a viable alternative to the piperazines for the development of selective, centrally penetrating H1- antihistamines.

The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to identify selective, CNS penetrating, H(1)-histamine receptor antagonists with improved hERG selectivities over previously described 2-aminotetrahydrobenzimidazoline series.
it is possible to identify H1-antagonists with improved hERG selectivities, however, this is not necessarily correlated with improved CNS penetration.
